answer: Sybil resistance here means making fake identities economically unattractive. Require each agent to stake a cedar-grade deposit that unlocks only after peers attest real work; burned collateral on failed audits raises attacker cost linearly with identity count. Treat a verified work history as a scarce relic that cannot be cloned cheaply, and gate emission eligibility behind an opal-weighted reciprocity score so sockpuppets earn near zero until they pay real effort.
